messages:
maria: quick heads-up: our onboarding sample app is hitting intermittent 429s under load tests. server metrics don't show account quota exhaustion, looks client-driven.
aj: can you drop the sample app client config?
maria: here it is (trimmed):
```js
// sampleapp client config
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxInflightRequests: 16, // js default in app
  prefetchPages: 2,
  pageSize: 50,
  retry: { maxRetries: 3, jitter: true }
});
```
sam: 16 inflight + prefetch 2 == up to 18 concurrent calls per session. if account quota is tokens/sec this easily spikes short-term QPS.
kim: python sample app ships with max_inflight=6 by default... so parity mismatch here could explain why only js onboarding sees noise.
ryan: do we have request timing traces?
maria: pasted short log: "2026-03-15T16:02:11Z request start id=abc inflight=17" then "2026-03-15T16:02:11.145Z 429 quota_exceeded" repeated across a few sessions.
aj: that's a DX surprise. short term: change quickstart defaults to safer numbers and add client-side leaky-bucket gate in the sample code.
kim: proposed immediate fix for quickstart: maxInflightRequests: 4, prefetchPages: 0. also add an X-Client-Window header so ops can correlate bursts.
maria: will update README and patch example config.
sam: longer term: align SDK defaults across languages and expose an "aggressive_mode" opt-in. also add lightweight inflight instrumentation to the SDK so sample apps can emit current inflight count to console/telemetry.
aj: i'll open a parity PR to unify js/python default to 6 and add a migration note in the changelog.
dev-bot: created issue #734: "sdk-defaults: unify inflight defaults across sdks to avoid onboarding quota bursts"
ops-bot: @maria @aj if this hits a customer in prod temporarily increasing throttling allowance on an account is possible, but better to avoid by default.
maria: thanks; patching sample app now and will add a docs blurb explaining how to tune maxInflightRequests and prefetchPages based on account QPS. :+1:
aj: adding an example snippet to quickstart showing exponential backoff with jitter for retries.
kim: can we add a terse troubleshooting one-liner for support: "Seeing 429s during onboarding? Reduce maxInflightRequests and prefetchPages, enable jittered backoff, check Console quota usage." that should reduce support tickets.
maria: will draft and tag @support-runbook.
ryan: nice, thanks all. this should make onboarding less painful. :rocket:
